```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)

NPVisit<- read_csv("../data/All National Parks Visitation 1904-2016.csv")

NPVisit<-NPVisit%>%
  dplyr::select(`Gnis Id`, Parkname:YearRaw)%>%
  drop_na()%>%
  filter(YearRaw %in% c("2007", "2008", "2009", "2010", "2011","2012", "2013", "2014", "2015", "2016"))

```
